about.heroTitle: One codebase, nine ends, one AI
about.heroSubtitle: IHUI AI is an open-source full-stack AI operating system that brings Agent design, knowledge base, multi-model dispatch, cross-platform collaboration and team operations into a single platform.
about.storyP1: In 2024, we discovered that companies adopting AI universally face a 'four-piece problem': choosing models is hard, integrating a knowledge base is hard, cross-platform distribution is hard, and team collaboration & billing is hard. Existing products either solve just one, are closed-source and locked-in, or cost too much to use.
about.storyP2: So we built IHUI AI: open-source, unified, cross-platform, self-hostable. We compressed what would take 12-18 months of in-house development into a 30-minute sign-up.
about.valueOpenDesc: Apache 2.0 license, core code public, commercial use allowed, zero self-host cost.
about.valueCrossDesc: Web / Desktop / Mini Program / Browser Extension / React Native / CLI, one codebase, one publish, reach every platform.
about.valueFreeDesc: 1,000 credits monthly, all models, all nine ends. Pro from ¥49/month, Enterprise supports self-hosting.
about.valueEnterpriseDesc: SSO/OAuth, audit logs, role-based access, self-hosting, serving multiple listed companies.
about.platformAgentsDesc: Visual drag-and-drop to build AI Agents, 200+ templates, plugin/MCP tools, one-click publish to any client.
about.platformRagDesc: PDF/Word/Markdown/web parsing, vector + BM25 hybrid retrieval, Chinese-friendly, knowledge graph.
about.platformModelsDesc: OpenAI/Claude/Qwen/DeepSeek/Zhipu/ERNIE/Doubao/Kimi/Ollama one-click switch, auto fallback, cost routing.
about.platformMcpDesc: Native Model Context Protocol support, connect any MCP Server, 100+ pre-built in tool marketplace.
about.platformWorkflowDesc: n8n-style node canvas, triggers + LLM + tools + branches + human-in-the-loop.
about.platformCollabDesc: Multi-tenant workspace, role permissions, credit sharing, audit logs, SSO/OAuth.
about.ctaTitle: Start your AI journey in 30 minutes
about.ctaDesc: Sign up and get 1,000 credits, free trial of all models, no credit card required.
